> **⚠️ This is a release candidate, not a final release.** Expect bugs, rough edges, and the occasional thing that breaks outright. Run it on a test machine, or make sure you have a working backup (or a snapshot you know how to roll back to) before you upgrade a machine you depend on.

Omarchy 4.5 is the first feature release since Quattro. It speaks 50 languages, gives every monitor its own workspaces, adds floating workspaces with a dock, rebuilds notifications, gathers how the desktop looks into a new Appearance menu, plays theme intros, and ships four new default apps: Hype, Monologue, Signed, and Disktree. Underneath, it installs in about half the time, it's faster from boot to theme switching, and it runs on NVIDIA N1x and Snapdragon X laptops.

Try it on an existing machine with `Update > Channel > RC`, then `Update > Omarchy`. Please report anything that breaks on [GitHub](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/issues).

Install on new machines with the ISO:

**x86_64:**

- Download: [https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-x86.iso](https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-x86.iso)
- SHA256: 715d7c72d51c29a1e2db7b8f8562d54f0f5710b9c1c5a4243800be48fba24269

**aarch64:**

- Download: [https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-aarch64.iso](https://iso.omarchy.org/omarchy-4.5.0-rc3-aarch64.iso)

## Breaking changes

**The boot menu stays out of the way now.** Limine waits 1 second instead of about 6 and boots quietly, so most of the time you won't see the menu at all. That's fine for 90% of boots. When you need a different entry or a snapshot, keep tapping any key (the down arrow works) while the machine starts and it'll stop at the menu. To keep the menu up longer for good, set your own `timeout:` in `/boot/limine.conf` (for example `timeout: 5`); updates leave a timeout you set alone.

**Some shortcuts moved:**

- Calculator: `Super + Ctrl + Q` is now `Super + Shift + Q`.
- Activity: `Super + Ctrl + T` is now `Super + Shift + T`, and `Super + Ctrl + T` opens themes.
- Network: `Super + Ctrl + W` is now `Super + Ctrl + N`, and `Super + Ctrl + W` opens backgrounds.
- Nightlight no longer has a shortcut (it was `Super + Ctrl + N`); it's in `Trigger > Toggle`.
- `Super + Alt + Space` opens Apps from the dock instead of the Apps menu.

**Notification shortcuts changed:**

- `Super + Comma` acts on the newest card (dismisses it, opens it, or presses its one button) instead of only dismissing it.
- Dismissing the last one moved to `Super + Alt + Comma`, which used to open it.
- Silencing moved from `Super + Ctrl + Comma` to `Super + Ctrl + Alt + Comma`; `Super + Ctrl + Comma` now hands you keyboard control.

**A few keys work differently:**

- `Super + Tab`, `Super + Shift + Tab`, `Super + Ctrl + Tab`, and `Super` + scroll stay on the current monitor's workspaces, since every monitor has its own.
- In a terminal, `Super + C` and `Super + V` send `Ctrl + Shift + C` and `Ctrl + Shift + V` instead of `Ctrl + Insert` and `Shift + Insert`.

New defaults that could collide with bindings of your own: `Super + Q` (close window, alongside `Super + W`), `Super + A` (select all), `Super + M` (minimize to the dock), `Super + Grave` and `Super + Shift + Grave` (Quake console), `Super + Alt + L` (previous layout), `Super + Shift + Ctrl + Arrows` (move a window to another monitor), `Super + Ctrl + Alt + C` (screenshot), `Super + Ctrl + Alt + E` (world clock), `Super + Ctrl + Alt + F` (full screen desktop), and holding `Right Alt` for push-to-talk dictation.

## Highlights

### Add Omarchy in 50 languages

Pick a language under _Setup > Language_ or run `omarchy language <code>`. The menu, desktop, and Omarchy's notifications switch immediately, and the system locale follows on next login.

![679589139-929b33cd-a4d3-4643-8c98-1e9afa43f41f.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjIsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d9f3ad8af418bb328acee15e372ab3b8d29fb0f6/679589139-929b33cd-a4d3-4643-8c98-1e9afa43f41f.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Add floating workspaces with a dock

`Super + L` now cycles a workspace between dwindle tiling, scrolling, and floating, and the bar shows which layout each workspace uses. On a floating workspace every window floats with a titlebar in your theme's colors, and a dock shows your pinned apps, everything running, and a grid of every app. Drag to reorder or pin, right-click for more, and set the dock's position and auto-hide under _Appearance > Dock_. `Super + M` minimizes a window to the dock.

![679594269-a41993de-ba41-4b76-bd7e-a3eeb524335c.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjMsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--e5b2eb992a82ec450216900f3507546a55a65bbb/679594269-a41993de-ba41-4b76-bd7e-a3eeb524335c.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

![3i7ohwhi35z24x3ft28dpgd48boy?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NzcsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--843a91659e916c2e8b100b214101f406598f7148/3i7ohwhi35z24x3ft28dpgd48boy?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Give each monitor its own workspaces

`Super + 1-0` now goes to the workspaces of the monitor you're on, and each monitor gets its own set of workspaces. You're also able to navigate intelligently using `Super + Arrows` to navigate to and from other displays. This combination provides a much more consistent and predictable experience for multi-monitor users.

![679593964-336a2084-ae90-469f-a2af-c11fcd514948.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjQsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--afb3057203c9e3ea48331f3849899f98a8647221/679593964-336a2084-ae90-469f-a2af-c11fcd514948.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Add new, enhanced notifications

Notifications now stack by sender. Action buttons, verification codes, and links work right from the card, and cards follow your theme. Identical notifications from the same sender collapse into one.

`Super + Comma` acts on the newest card: it dismisses it, opens it, or presses its one button, and hands you the keyboard when there's more than one choice. `Super + Ctrl + Comma` takes you straight there; number keys press buttons, `Enter` clicks the card, and the arrow keys move between cards. The bell in the bar turns on Do Not Disturb, and `Super + Shift + Alt + Comma` brings back the last day of notifications.

![5qi4dftbzuiekk7jvm153hp4rlca?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NzgsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--138131f9583be3189805d1bc10375c42621c7207/5qi4dftbzuiekk7jvm153hp4rlca?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Add an Appearance menu for how the desktop looks

Everything about how the desktop looks now lives in one top-level Appearance menu, right before Trigger, and it takes over the old Style menu: theme, background, font, the menu bar, windows (gaps, corners, opacity, and the one-window ratio), branding, the dock, each workspace's layout, animations, and the unlock screen.

![omarchy-4.5-appearance.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjYsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--f18e10bc6b581bbd8aa9abc530733758d8a5b649/omarchy-4.5-appearance.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Add video wallpapers and theme intros

Backgrounds can be videos on the desktop, now played by OWE, and the lock screen shows a still frame from them. Themes play a short silent intro at login and when you switch to them; turn intros off under _Appearance > Animations_.

### Introduce the F1 installer for even faster installs

The new F1 installer unpacks a prebuilt root image and adds this machine's packages on top, instead of installing about 940 packages one by one. This results in incredibly faster install times!

![t1pivc76x4y9fs4u4h9q8dq9qsaa?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NzksInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--340391f946c5240260852493b1a681db6b36404e/t1pivc76x4y9fs4u4h9q8dq9qsaa?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Boot in about a second, quietly

Limine's menu wait drops from about six seconds to one, boot is silent, and binfmt registration no longer stalls startup. Press any key during boot to reach the menu.

### Speed up theme switching, menus, panels, and the bash prompt

The theme picker opens right away instead of after about 245 ms. Menus and panels open straight from Hyprland shortcuts, so a keypress no longer starts a process first (about 60 ms each time). The Omarchy menu's three slowest checks went from about 200 ms to about 16 ms, a new terminal shows its prompt about 30 ms sooner, and the desktop reacts to changes instead of polling for them.

### Add Hype, Signed, Disktree, and Monologue as default apps

Hype makes presentations out of a single Markdown file, with a visual slide editor beside the source, and exports to PDF or PowerPoint.

![omarchy-4.5-hype.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjcsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--0a097d7587ddffa89175a1bfa9a7b8984d3ef89c/omarchy-4.5-hype.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

Signed replaces Xournal++ for the paperwork: open a PDF, place your saved signature, text, and dates on it, and save a signed copy.

![omarchy-4.5-signed.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjgsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--712442637c5b191f924a97957b8a74f8cf992d83/omarchy-4.5-signed.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

Disktree replaces the Disk Usage TUI with a treemap of what fills a disk, colored by kind, with the regenerable caches worth a look called out, so you can mark what should go and remove it.

![omarchy-4.5-disktree.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NjksInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--3e91ab896c3d585a551f85f38ddd6229385c4941/omarchy-4.5-disktree.jpg?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

Monologue records your camera with one key, themed to match the desktop. Omasnap takes over screenshots from Tensaku, and gliff gives you a remote desktop over SSH.

### Add Elsewhen, a built-in world clock

Elsewhen sits next to the clock. Tap a city on the globe to set "here", search real places, name the people in a city, flip 12/24-hour with `t` and °F/°C with `Alt + T`, and summon it with `Super + Ctrl + Alt + E`.

![679594484-4c9a9408-3d72-4215-a7e3-33dc1b4ebd31.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NzAsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--d9dd7d34f23fab85a72856b3a4eb461587ba60cb/679594484-4c9a9408-3d72-4215-a7e3-33dc1b4ebd31.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)

### Add a Quake-style terminal console

`Super + Grave` drops a centered, dimmed terminal console over the desktop, a handy home for a terminal agent. The full-size scratchpad stays on its own on `Super + S`.

![679594761-624f03ec-c7fb-4407-a3bd-27e4f19975d4.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2](https://app.sendherald.com/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6eyJpZCI6NzEsInRlbmFudCI6ImFjY291bnQtMDNnNzZsMmtrejcxNTVxdWlyZmh0cGxpMiJ9LCJwdXIiOiJ0ZW5hbnRfYmxvYl9pZCJ9fQ==--13e51ae7bb6bcb65ef28dc3c41e2d2811383c4b3/679594761-624f03ec-c7fb-4407-a3bd-27e4f19975d4.gif?tenant=account-03g76l2kkz7155quirfhtpli2)
